richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Surendranagar Dudhrej

c: Surendranagar and Dudhrej together make up one of the main towns of the Jhalawad area, on the dry plains between Saurashtra and the Little Rann of Kutch. Summers are long and very hot, and rain is limited to a short monsoon. As an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Surendranagar Dudhrej, FunPlay Systems serves schools, colleges, municipal gardens and residential societies from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 400 km away.

The town is a trading centre for cotton and other farm produce, and most open spaces here are school grounds, society gardens and public parks. Each of these can take a small open gym with three to six machines. We plan it from your photos and measurements, send a layout drawing, and install with our team or a dealer in western India. Many buyers here start with a few machines and add more once residents begin using them.

richText.heading: Shade, timing and surfaces in a hot, dry town

c: Plan the gym around the hours people will use it, which here means early morning and after sunset for most of the year. A shaded corner of the garden or a simple shed over the stations makes a big difference. Lighting lets people exercise after dark in the hottest months.

items.q: Is an outdoor gym practical in a very hot town?
items.a: Yes, if it is shaded and lit. Most people exercise early in the morning and in the evening anyway, so plan the location around those hours.

items.q: How far is your factory from Surendranagar?
items.a: About 400 km. The equipment is made in Vasai near Mumbai and sent to Gujarat by road, then installed by our team or a dealer in the west.

items.q: Can a school compound fit an open gym?
items.a: Usually, yes. Three to six machines along one edge of the ground take little space. Send us the dimensions and we will mark the layout.
